description: Round 3 (DOSBox-X, Tandy, avi/tandy_r3_session.avi): the attract, the walk-off, the sign-in, Ada's saved game, Flutter's hint, a coin toss, a net swing, the Help menu; the AVI frames at the engine ticks of their time (engine PIT tick = AVI time x 236.695 + 10336, from the title music), the keys at the ticks the AVI shows them (the walk-off's Enter 3 ticks before its redrawn title: the original draws it in a long frame). avi_f00421 (that long frame) and avi_f01185 (the resumed game's screen, about 8 ticks after Yes) match since the engine shows a long frame's picture when the frame ends, as the original presents it
